decks.notes: The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan by using a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill, and powerful threats like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to control the game by disrupting your opponent?s resources and board state while slowly grinding them out with powerful threats and card advantage. The deck's win condition revolves around overwhelming your opponent with powerful creatures and locking them out of the game with cards like Liliana of the Veil and Sorin the Mirthless.

This deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. Utilizing cards like Witch's Oven and Cauldron Familiar alongside Mayhem Devil allows for consistent damage output. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of synergy and versatility to the deck. By combining aggressive creature plays with sacrifice effects, this Rakdos Sacrifice deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats and disruption, ultimately leading to victory through attrition and board control.

This deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor out powerful creatures and lock down the board with Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown. It relies on controlling the opponent's board while ramping up and eventually overwhelming them with big threats like Agent of Treachery, Omnath, Locus of Creation, and Koma, Cosmos Serpent. The deck also takes advantage of Fires of Invention to cast multiple spells each turn and generate value. The companion, Keruga, the Macrosage, ensures a high curve and consistent card draw.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Reckless Stormseeker to apply pressure on opponents early in the game. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, as well as versatile removal spells like Obliterating Bolt. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and synergy with the deck's overall strategy. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and impactful spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate large amounts of mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays and combo potential. The key strategy is to assemble the necessary pieces to enable big mana plays through tutoring effects, card draw, and untapping Lotus Field multiple times in a turn. By efficiently ramping up mana and finding key combo pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and win the game in a single turn.

This deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence using efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. It also utilizes powerful removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to control the board. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to quickly apply pressure to the opponent while having access to versatile removal options. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion ensures that the deck can consistently ramp up and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Lotus Field along with cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This deck also includes various tutoring cards such as Behold the Beyond and Dark Petition to search for key combo pieces like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The inclusion of cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Mastermind's Acquisition allow for flexibility and resilience in finding answers to different situations. Overall, the deck aims to set up a powerful combo while maintaining control and searching for key cards.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and then overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. The inclusion of cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival helps to further accelerate the deck's game plan, while cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Oath of Nissa provide additional mana fixing and card selection. Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God and Karn, the Great Creator offer late-game power and versatility to ensure victory.

This deck focuses on using low-cost, evasive Spirits to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. By leveraging cards that provide additional value, such as Curious Obsession and Spell Queller, the deck aims to control the game tempo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of counter spells like Lofty Denial and removal like Geistlight Snare complement the aggressive nature of the deck, allowing it to maintain board dominance while limiting the opponent's options. Overall, the deck prioritizes speed, disruption, and strategic advantage to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with various mana dorks and enchantments, then utilize green devotion to cast powerful creatures and planeswalkers. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and a strong board presence, while also utilizing cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to generate card advantage and maintain pressure. It combines efficient ramp with powerful threats to create a fast-paced and high-powered strategy that aims to win games in the early to mid game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang, Okiba Boss to create tokens and generate value through sacrificing and recurring creatures. It also includes cards like Grisly Salvage, Satyr Wayfinder, and Raffine's Informant to fill the graveyard and find key combo pieces. The deck has a mix of lands that support its color requirements and includes cards like Esika's Chariot and Parhelion II for additional token generation and threats. In addition, cards like Thoughtseize and Eldritch Evolution provide disruption and tutoring capabilities to help execute the combo efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field in combination with cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands, Hidden Strings, and Sylvan Scrying to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently. This allows the player to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Behold the Beyond to search for key combo pieces and finish the game with cards like Omniscience and Mastermind's Acquisition. The deck also utilizes Boseiju, Who Endures to protect its important spells from countermagic. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells.

The deck focuses on quickly building up a board of aggressive creatures, such as Righteous Valkyrie, Bishop of Wings, and Resplendent Angel, to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also makes use of Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Collected Company to generate mana and find more creatures efficiently. The inclusion of Skyclave Apparition and Giada, Font of Hope helps to deal with opposing threats and gain life to stay ahead in the game. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong presence on the battlefield to secure victory.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Witch's Oven, and Cauldron Familiar to deal damage to opponents while sacrificing creatures for benefit. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board and disrupt opponent's strategies. With a mix of sacrifice effects, value generation, and direct damage, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with relentless pressure and efficient resource management.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells, while also using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to generate card advantage and control the board. The deck also utilizes alternate win conditions such as Shark Typhoon and March of Otherworldly Light to pressure the opponent and close out games. The mana base is designed to support the deck's spells and ensure consistent access to all necessary colors of mana.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures. It includes cards that generate creature tokens, gain life, and provide additional value when creatures enter the battlefield. The mana base ensures a smooth curve for consistent plays. Cards like Collected Company and Skyclave Apparition help to maintain control of the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain momentum to secure the win.
